relativeToByok.referenceNote: ONE named reference engine (not best-per-metric). Measured on the same split at N>=3; per-run mean of each metric. The BYOK default moved to Claude Haiku 5.5 on 2026-10-11: the Claude Haiku 4.5 reference run is retired, and the committed anthropic*.json artifacts (measured on Haiku 4.5) no longer match this model, so a new Haiku 5.5 reference run is required before any FM-vs-BYOK relative gate is trusted.
relativeToByok.refusal: absolute only: targets.refusal (0.95) plus a per-subtype report. Never compared to the max over engines or to BYOK.
